name: cozy-doc
description: Turns hard-to-follow material into something you can read top to bottom without ever wondering where to start. diff-guide reorders a diff (uncommitted changes, a branch comparison, or a GitHub PR) by reading dependency instead of file path, adds a one-line reason to read each file, and trims excerpts to just the parts that matter. seq-values pairs a Mermaid sequence diagram (shape only) with a concrete real-value walkthrough of every arrow, so implementation details are shared without room for interpretation. Both produce a standalone HTML page a reviewer or your future self can follow without guessing.
